entities.name: Ham1p-like pyrophosphatase
observations: 195-aa sequence has Pfam Ham1p_like (PF01725.22) match at residues 3–185 (i-Evalue 1.2e-49).
Homologous reviewed archaeal proteins annotated as dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases; strongest hit Q8ZVB5 has 53.3% identity and 92.3% query coverage (E=1.48e-51).
Probable Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates to monophosphates; substrate preference is inferred from homology, not directly tested for this query.

entities.name: Purine NTP catabolism
observations: Homolog annotations associate dITP/XTP/ITP diphosphatase activity with purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolism (GO:0009146).
